program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((black-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                        (find (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c)))
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (black-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                        (find (lambda (r) (zero? (at g r c)))
                                              (range 0 h)))
                                      (range 0 w))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (or
                            (find (lambda (br) (= r br)) black-rows)
                            (find (lambda (bc) (= c bc)) black-cols))
                          (if (= v 2) 2 0)
                          v))))))
